morning.text: Let's go back to yesterday morning, from when you got up until lunchtime. Take a moment to picture where you were. Then tell me everything you can remember: who you were with, where you went, what was talked about, and anything that got decided.
Think back to yesterday morning. Where were you, and who was around? Tell me everything that comes to mind: people, places, conversations, and any plans or decisions. Take your time.
I'd like to hear about yesterday morning. Picture the start of it, then talk me through as much as you can: who you saw, where you were, what you talked about, and how things were left.
Cast your mind back to yesterday morning, up to lunchtime. Tell me about it in as much detail as you can: the people, the places, the conversations, and anything that was agreed. There's no rush.

afternoon.text: Let's go back to yesterday afternoon, from lunchtime onwards. Take a moment to picture where you were. Then tell me everything you can remember: who you were with, where you went, what was talked about, and anything that got decided.

I'd like to hear about yesterday afternoon. Picture the start of it, then talk me through as much as you can: who you saw, where you were, what you talked about, and how things were left.
Cast your mind back to yesterday afternoon. Tell me about it in as much detail as you can: the people, the places, the conversations, and anything that was agreed. There's no rush.

evening.text: Let's go back to yesterday evening, from about six until you went to bed. Take a moment to picture where you were. Then tell me everything you can remember: who you were with, where you were, what was talked about, and anything that got decided.
Think back to yesterday evening. Where were you, and who was around? Tell me everything that comes to mind: people, places, conversations, and any plans or decisions. Take your time.
I'd like to hear about yesterday evening. Picture the start of it, then talk me through as much as you can: who you saw, where you were, what you talked about, and how things were left.
Cast your mind back to yesterday evening. Tell me about it in as much detail as you can: the people, the places, the conversations, and anything that was agreed. There's no rush.

day.text: Let's go back to yesterday, from when you got up until bed. Take a moment to picture how it started. Then talk me through it: who you were with, where you went, what was talked about, anything that got decided, and the highs and lows too.
Think back over yesterday. Tell me everything that comes to mind: people, places, conversations, plans or decisions, and how the day felt. Take your time.

I'd like to hear about your day yesterday. Start wherever feels natural and talk me through as much as you can: who you saw, where you were, what you talked about, how things were left, and the highs and lows.
Cast your mind back to yesterday. Tell me about it in as much detail as you can: the people, the places, the conversations, anything that was agreed, and how it all felt. There's no rush.

followUps.second: Anything else at all, even small things?
Even small details count. Anything else?
Anything at all, even if you're not sure?

handling.when: Silence for 8 seconds or more after the opener
handling.text: Take your time. Wherever you'd like to start is fine.
That's okay. Even one small thing is fine. Wherever comes to mind.

handling.when: Nothing happened or it was a quiet day
handling.text: That's fine, quiet times count too. Anything at all, however small?

handling.when: Talks about a different part of the day
handling.text: Thanks. Thinking just about the {window}, anything else?

handling.when: Did I get it right? or How am I doing?
handling.text: I'll go through everything once we've finished.

handling.when: Asks for a hint or reminder
handling.text: I can't give hints during this part, but I can show you everything afterwards if you'd like.

handling.when: Talks about feelings or goes off on a tangent

handling.text: No problem. Carry on whenever you're ready.
Of course. We'll stop there, and nothing from today has been saved.

handling.when: Frustration, self-criticism, or worry about their memory
handling.text: Let's leave it there for today. Nothing's been saved, and we can try again another time.

closing.text: Thanks, that's everything I need for today.

v2.note: Starter templates. Do not ask these in v1.

cuedRecall.template: You mentioned {topic}. Who was that with?
When you were at {place}, who did you see?
When you saw {person}, where was that?
With {person}, what did you get up to?
What did you and {person} talk about?
At {place}, what was the conversation about?
When you talked about {topic}, was anything agreed?
When you saw {person}, was that earlier or later on?
When you talked with {person}, did any particular thing come up, something bought, lent or needed?
During the conversation about {topic}, was a particular item mentioned?
When you talked about {topic}, did a number or amount come up?
With {person}, was there a figure or a count mentioned?

recognition.template: Which of these happened yesterday {window}? You can pick more than one, or none: {options}.

temporalOrder.template: Put these in the order they happened: {event_a}, {event_b}, {event_c}.
